name: Dour Port-Mage
description: Whenever one or more other creatures you control leave the battlefield without dying, draw a card. {1}{U}, {T}: Return another target creature you control to its owner's hand.
notes: Found and fixed a real gap: "leaves the battlefield WITHOUT DYING" (Destination$ being a comma list of every zone except Graveyard) is a distinct, real rules concept from plain "dies" -- fell through to the unreadable literal 'changeszoneall' before. Added an isLeavesWithoutDying check mirroring isEnter/isDies exactly. Verified node C now shows trigger-type:"leaves-without-dying". In blb-success.json.
